title: 1812 Grimm Cinderella: No Fairy Godmother or Glass Slipper, Why Cut the Heel?
description:
In the 1812 first edition of Grimms' Fairy Tales, Cinderella had no fairy godmother, pumpkin carriage, or glass slippers.
She was helped by a tree planted on her mother's grave and white doves, wearing golden slippers to the ball.
To fit into the shoe, the mother handed a knife to the sisters, cutting off a heel and a toe!
Even more shocking: the Grimms did not soften the tale over time—in 1819 they made it far more brutal, adding doves that pecked out both sisters' eyes...
